verdict.rationale: Browserbase ships a built-in 'Agent' feature where users describe a goal in natural language from the dashboard, the agent can pause mid-run to ask for input and resume, and an Optimize tool refines its behavior into a reusable script — this is a genuine built-in AI assistant for delegating web tasks. However it's scoped narrowly to browser automation (not a general-purpose assistant) and evidence is entirely first-party docs with no independent hands-on validation. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of the built-in Agent's real-world reliability, and evidence of broader task scope beyond browsing.
